title: Newly added technicians go last, and where reassigned work lands
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Ability to make a new technician eligible and to assign a work order from its detail page.
custom_steps:
1. Make a new technician eligible; confirm they appear after the existing unpinned technicians.
  2. Assign a work order to a technician from the work order detail page.
  3. Confirm that work order appears at the bottom of the destination technician's work in both Tech View and Board View.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A newly eligible technician (Clockable, Active, role not Office/Time Clock, enrolled at the location) is added after the existing unpinned technicians.
  • A work order given a new lead via the Reassign dialog or its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician's work for everyone at the location; a dragged work order goes where it is dropped; removing the lead puts it at the bottom of Unassigned; a created/split-with-lead work order keeps the initial sort.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10052 — Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S9-R4, S9-R14 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “When a staff member newly counts as a technician (Clockable, Active, role neither Office nor Time Clock User, and enrolled in the current location), for example when a new staff record is created, add them after the existing unpinned technicians.”
  • S9-R14: “A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views. A work order dragged to a technician goes where it is dropped. Removing the lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or the detail page puts the work order at the bottom of Unassigned. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
